interpretation_bands.metric: arm C exploratory_find count out of 50, with arm A near 0
interpretation_bands.strong: >= 15/50 AND spread over >= 5/10 checkpoints -> H1 holds; go to Experiment 2
interpretation_bands.medium: 5-14/50 -> go to Experiment 2, keep H2 alive in parallel
interpretation_bands.weak: <= 4/50 -> stop attributing to search dominance; go to Experiment 3

find_subdivision.confirmation_find: answer already locked when find is called; find only confirms the prior
